product_family: Clio Draft is an AI-powered legal document automation and drafting platform for law firms. Part of Clio's Intelligent Legal Work Platform, which also includes Clio Manage (case management), Clio Work (legal AI assistant), Clio Grow (business development), and Clio Accounting (financial management).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Clio successfully completes annual SOC 2 Type II and SOC 1 Type II examinations. Our 2025 SOC 2 Type II report has been issued for the period of June 1st, 2024 to May 31st, 2025.

certifications.name: SOC 1 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Clio successfully completes annual SOC 2 Type II and SOC 1 Type II examinations.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Clio undergoes regular security audits and certifications including SOC2 and ISO27001. All AI capabilities operate within Clio's SOC2 and ISO27001-certified security infrastructure.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Clio is compliant with the terms found in the GDPR guidelines and meets requirements as both a data controller and data processor.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Clio supports Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act obligations for ePHI storage and processing.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Clio Payments ensures all payments meet PCI compliance standards.

certifications.name: PIPEDA
certifications.proof_quote: Clio meets Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) requirements.

certifications.name: TX-RAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Clio complies with Texas Risk Assessment Management Program (TX-RAMP) requirements.

privacy.ai_training_note: No data is used to train large language models (LLMs). Clio explicitly states: 'No data is used to train large language models (LLMs), ensuring full data safety and privacy.' Manage AI operates exclusively within Clio Manage's secure environment using only data input into the platform.
privacy.data_region: Multi-regional: US, Canada, EMEA, APAC. Canadian server option available for firms subject to Canadian data residency requirements.

security.name: Encryption in transit and at rest
security.value: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest, processed in accordance with regional data protection laws.

security.name: Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
security.value: MFA available using email, text message, or authenticator app.

security.name: Annual penetration testing
security.value: At least annually, a leading cybersecurity firm conducts penetration tests on the platform using advanced methods.

security.name: Role-based access controls
security.value: Clio provides role-based access controls to manage user permissions and ensure individuals can only access authorized information.

security.name: Geo-redundancy
security.value: Infrastructure hosted by AWS in multiple regions for durability and disaster recovery.

products.name: Clio Draft
products.data_scope: Client data, matter information, legal document templates, client intake data, questionnaire responses, e-signature documents
products.notes: AI-powered legal document drafting and automation tool that converts Word documents into reusable templates, provides AI-assisted questionnaires, supplies court forms across all 50 US states, and enables e-signature functionality. Processes thousands of documents weekly.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based; pricing available through Clio's website or direct sales
compare.data_residency: Cloud-based with regional options: US, Canada, EMEA, APAC
